name: ss14mapper
description: Map editor for Space Station 14 that runs in the browser

scripts.test-map: rolldown tools/ci-test-map.ts --format esm --platform node -o node_modules/.cache/ci-test-map.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/ci-test-map.mjs
scripts.new-map: rolldown tools/new-map.ts --format esm --platform node -o node_modules/.cache/new-map.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/new-map.mjs
scripts.build-pack: rolldown tools/build-pack.ts --format esm --platform node --external sharp --external js-yaml -o node_modules/.cache/build-pack.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/build-pack.mjs
